reason: `do principal` was added to restore recall and matches the adjectival use in `o comportamento do principal índice brasileiro`. Second time in this campaign that a form I added to fix something was itself wrong — `até` was the first. A collocation added as a repair needs the same exhaustive sweep as a form found in the wild.

operations.why: One of the two occurrences of `do principal` is `replicar o comportamento do principal índice brasileiro, o Ibovespa` — the ordinary adjective. The other, `a mudança do principal (correção pelo CPI)`, is the TIPS principal and is why the collocation exists.
